summary: Blockout kits (D9 + D10): a building's cube or multi-cube envelope and a machine's riveted-iron blockout built from the C10 and C14 records alone, through SetpieceMeshFactory, with every socket and pivot the record names as an empty Node3D a rig can find, and a review scene that shows all five at gameplay distance under the island environment.

coordination.notes: Reads content/buildings/*.json and content/machines/*.json through ContentCatalog and content/presentation/board.registry.json by entry ID; authors no content. Does not touch game/scripts/world/ (SetpieceMeshFactory is called, not edited), game/scripts/board/ (P10), game/scripts/ui/ (P11), godot-rust/ or tools/. Placement on the board is P10's or a later card's; this card ships the kits and the build(record) -> Node3D seam.
